caption_L1: Here a is a line diagram titled Aggregated political composition of all states in the United States between 2008 and 2018 , by party affiliation. The x-axis plots Year on linear scale from 2008 to 2016 while the y-axis measures Solid Republican with linear scale of range 0 to 14.
caption_L2L3: Between 2008 and 2009 the number of republicans remained the same. The number also stayed the same between 2016 and 2017. The number of republican supporters rose sharply between 2010 and 2011 and again between 2014 and 2016.
